operations.name: generate
operations.description: Single-turn or multi-turn text generation via generateContent. The endpoint path embeds the model name (/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent) rather than carrying it in the body — this connector substitutes input.model into the path at call time. Auth uses the x-goog-api-key header (the current documented mechanism), never the legacy ?key= query-string form, so the key is never written into a URL that could end up in access logs.

data_flows: input.messages (role 'system' entries sent separately as systemInstruction) and input.model/max_tokens/temperature are sent, as JSON, to provider.base_url (or its base_url_override_env override, when explicitly configured) over HTTPS.
No data is sent anywhere else — there is no secondary destination, logging sink, or analytics call in this connector.
The provider's full raw response is returned to the caller unmodified as output.raw; nothing is dropped, redacted, or summarized before being handed back.
